title: When the tongue gets ahead of the soul
issueStatement: Your words are sharper than your conscience, or sweeter than your heart actually is.
centralInsight: Guru does not treat speech as cosmetic. Speech reveals what the heart is feeding on and what it still loves too much.
practicalReflection: The same mouth can protect dignity, wound people, advertise ego, or carry Naam. The question is not whether you speak, but what spirit your speech serves.
actionPrompt: Choose one conversation today where you will lower the heat, refuse contempt, and speak in a way you can still respect tonight.

source.shortMeaning: Speech that carries honor is acceptable; harsh speech only returns grief.
source.lifeApplication: Do not confuse release with righteousness.

excerpts.explanation: Guru names speech as morally weighty, not incidental.

source.shortMeaning: Sweet speech is credible when it grows inside humility and saint company.
source.lifeApplication: Tone matters most when it is backed by posture.

excerpts.explanation: This keeps speech from becoming performance.

source.shortMeaning: Where Guru speaks with honor, your language should not carry contempt.
source.lifeApplication: Let reverence revise your instincts of speech.

excerpts.explanation: Speech must also answer to Guru's social ethic.
